request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them).

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: The test asserted that list(todos) with default options returns completed items ("[x] milk\n[ ] eggs"). The instruction says the default must now hide completed todos. So the assertion was changed to expect "[ ] eggs", and a new assertion checks that includeDone: true still returns every todo.

approvals.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
